description: A webhook integration lets a third-party product that can call out to an HTTP endpoint have the traffic it handles inspected by Acuvity, with no code change in that product. It describes one vendor's webhook contract: the routes that vendor calls, and for each of them the lua script that turns its payload into something that can be scanned or policed, and the verdict back into the answer it expects. It is served by attaching it to an AI Gateway connector of type WebhookIntegration. The connector supplies the base path it is reachable under and the settings it runs with, so the same integration can be attached to several connectors.
